expected_ambiguities: Error code is not specified when an agency-specific status code is submitted under the other agency (e.g. 'WD' for MOODYS or 'WR' for FITCH).
Validation rules for agency NORTHBRIDGE are not stated, although it uses Fitch-style symbols elsewhere.

test_cases.title: Accept every Moody's-style long-term symbol
steps: Submit each of the 21 Moody's-style symbols from Aaa to C
Check the validation result for each
test_cases.expected_result: All 21 symbols are accepted and stored with is_rating=true.

test_cases.title: Accept every Fitch-style long-term symbol
steps: Submit each of the 23 Fitch-style symbols from AAA to D
Check the validation result for each
test_cases.expected_result: All 23 symbols are accepted and stored with is_rating=true.

test_cases.title: Reject a Moody's-style symbol submitted for FITCH
test_cases.expected_result: Rejected with RATING_SCALE_MISMATCH; nothing is stored.

test_cases.title: Reject a Fitch-style symbol submitted for MOODYS
test_cases.expected_result: Rejected with RATING_SCALE_MISMATCH; nothing is stored.

test_cases.title: Accept symbol 'C' for both agencies (shared symbol is not a mismatch)
test_cases.expected_result: Both are accepted; no RATING_SCALE_MISMATCH is raised.

test_cases.title: Reject symbols with the wrong case
Reject malformed and unknown symbols
steps: Submit each malformed symbol under its nearest agency

test_cases.title: Reject empty and whitespace-only symbols
test_cases.expected_result: Both are rejected with INVALID_RATING_SYMBOL (a whitespace-only symbol is empty after trimming).

test_cases.title: Store status codes with is_rating=false
steps: Submit WR and NR for MOODYS
Submit WD and NR for FITCH
test_cases.expected_result: All four are accepted and stored with is_rating=false.
